title: Jesus... I Was The One Who Hurt Her And Never Said Sorry
topic: hurt a friend years ago and never apologised

bible.text: If it is possible on your part, live at peace with everyone.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I hurt her, and I never said sorry. 😔

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Three years. She showed up in my suggestions today. I almost messaged her, then closed the app.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You've carried this for three years. That tells Me you still care.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: What if she reads it and never replies?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Sorry isn't a way to make her reply. It's a way to stop hiding.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Write the message. Leave the reply to Me.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to someone who still owes a sorry.
